scenes.title: When One Door Closes
scenes.summary: In the PS Management office, Paquita and Magüi struggle to take Macarena's framed poster down from the wall, quote a Spanish proverb about doors opening, and declare the start of their talent hunt.

scenes.title: The All-Round Actress
scenes.summary: Paquita and Magüi describe their ideal all-round actress who excels in drama, comedy, singing and dancing, before Magüi asks for breakfast and Paquita recalls that Macarena never ate breakfast.

scenes.title: Opening theme song
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence song following Paquita through the streets of Madrid.

scenes.title: The Showreel Shelf
scenes.summary: Paquita and Magüi pull actor showreels from the office shelf, defend the wealth of acting talent in Spain, and admire performers known by a single stage name like Carmen.

scenes.title: A Gem to Discover
scenes.summary: Sorting through more showreels on the shelf, Paquita and Magüi sound out actor Aakif Ndel's name, agree agencies need to broaden their perspective, and set his reel aside as a potential gem.

scenes.title: My Cousin's Showreel
scenes.summary: Courier Álex drops off a parcel for a neighbour, quietly asks Magüi how Paquita is coping, and asks an exasperated Paquita whether she has watched his cousin's showreel yet.

scenes.title: She Sent It Years Ago
scenes.summary: Thrilled by Hiba Abouk's old showreel, Paquita calls to offer representation until Hiba hangs up and Magüi gently explains that Hiba already stars in a hit series watched by six million people.

scenes.title: Everything Goes by Link
scenes.summary: Magüi explains internet links and posts a short casting call on an app with a word limit, while she and Paquita swear off salt over lunch and receive zero replies.

scenes.title: On the Boards
scenes.summary: Arriving at the Primera Fila drama school showcase, Paquita navigates the odd steps, mixes up playwright Henrik Ibsen with his character Hedda Gabler, and explains how stage acting reads from afar.

scenes.title: The Former You
scenes.summary: Paquita spots her former assistant Fernando Canelón in the audience, introduces him to Magüi as the former her, teases him for never calling, and hears about his thriving Red Carpet agency.

scenes.title: Look at That Girl
scenes.summary: As the student play begins, Paquita tells Magüi how fond she is of Fernando, shares her pre-show nerves, and whispers excitedly when student actress Mariona commands the stage as Hedda.

scenes.title: We Found Her
scenes.summary: Delighted by the play's finale, Paquita leaps to her feet cheering that Mariona is their all-round actress, before the school director invites special guest Fernando Canelón onto the stage.

scenes.title: Can I Borrow the Mic?
scenes.summary: Seeing Fernando slip his business card to Mariona onstage during his speech, Paquita climbs up, borrows the microphone, and warmly congratulates the students on behalf of PS Management.

scenes.title: Twenty-Five Years in the Business
scenes.summary: Paquita reminds everyone that Fernando started out with her, promises PS Management will turn one student into a star, and steps down just as the director names Macarena García as Fernando's newest client.

scenes.title: Not Macarena García
scenes.summary: Shocked, Paquita objects from the aisle that Fernando must mean another Macarena, until Fernando confirms onstage that Macarena García came to him herself and apologises for the scene.

scenes.title: Paquita Is Not Crazy
scenes.summary: Magüi stands up in front of the whole hall to defend Paquita against Fernando's coldness and explain why Macarena is still on the agency website, before the director orders them to leave.

scenes.title: Taking Off the Wig
scenes.summary: Moved by Paquita and Magüi, student actress Mariona pulls off her stage wig, calls out Fernando's heartless behaviour, urges her classmates to fight for their dreams, and declares she wants television roles.

scenes.title: You Are Going to Triumph
scenes.summary: Paquita cheers Mariona on from the aisle, promises she will star in Spain's biggest hit series, marches proudly out of the theatre with Magüi, and welcomes Mariona to PS Management.
scenes.location: Primera Fila theatre and PS Management office

scenes.title: Closing credits song
scenes.summary: Closing song over Paquita, Magüi and Mariona celebrating together at PS Management.
